atoms.sound: I am so excited to spend my Christmas break on the beach in Brazil! I will need a big suitcase to pack all the hot-weather essentials like my shorts and skirts. I also need to bring suncream and a cap to protect myself from the sun!

She is going to Spain.

atoms.sound: Since I am only going away for four days to visit my cousin, I’ll bring a small suitcase. I can’t pack too much, so, instead of four pairs of shoes, I am only taking two pairs. I still want to pack something fancy though because we’ll go out on Saturday evening.

b: ++She is going on a four-day holiday.
++She is visiting her cousin.
She is going on a ski holiday.
She is visiting her mother.

atoms.sound: I am packing for a family holiday. There’s going to be a lot of sun, so I am going to need my sunglasses, a cap and a bottle of suncream to protect my skin while I am swimming. My mum also wants us to bring a fancy shirt and a pair of trousers for her birthday meal in a restaurant.

atoms.sound: I am excited to visit my dad’s family and explore the city of Newcastle! It’s a short trip, so I’ll only need a couple of t-shirts and a pair of jeans. We are also going to the seaside one day, so I’ll bring my new, blue scarf to keep my neck warm! Unfortunately, it’s going to be raining a lot, so I am packing an umbrella and a raincoat to keep me dry.

He is visiting the park.
He is visiting the riverside.
He is visiting the castle.

atoms.sound: Hey Fatima, do you like going on city breaks?
No, I prefer going somewhere quiet like the countryside for my holidays. In fact, I am going to Pembrokeshire in Wales this week!
Oh, nice! I am going away too but I’m visiting Kyoto, a city in Japan. How long are you going to Wales for?
Only three days! The weather is not looking great though, it’s going to be very rainy.
At least you won’t need to pack much, right?
No, plus, it’s going to be warm despite the rain, so I just need some jeans, a couple of t-shirts and an umbrella. What about you?

Since I am going to Japan for 3 weeks, I’ll need to pack more. It should be quite warm during the day, but the nights are colder. So, I’m packing a thick coat, a jacket, a jumper, but also shorts and a few t-shirts.
Sounds like a plan! Good luck with all the packing. I hope the holiday is amazing!
